column1: # comment: "Notes & annotation alignments (annotation target span). W3C Web Annotation: GMEOW Annotation is a relator with provenance, confidence, temporal scope and suppression; oa:Annotation is a flatter body/target/motivation construct \u2014 closeMatch, not exactMatch. schema.org: GMEOW Note/Comment are information objects with full provenance; schema:NoteDigitalDocument / schema:Comment are flat document types \u2014 closeMatch. ActivityStreams: as:Note is a flat social-media note; GMEOW Note carries the full provenance stack \u2014 closeMatch. SIOC: sioc:Post / sioc:Reply are community-discussion items; GMEOW Comment is a reply note with threading \u2014 closeMatch. FOAF: foaf:maker is the flat authorship shortcut; GMEOW uses reified Participation / wasAttributedTo \u2014 closeMatch."
